SUMMARY.md: Random yes/no/maybe answers in themed oracle voices from yesnooracle.app. Knowledge source: the documentation page https://yesnooracle.app/api and live GET probes on 2026-10-23 (every tool, the force parameter, and an invalid tool). Corrections to the docs from the probes: a maybe answer carries verdict 'again', not 'maybe'; the server also accepts the undocumented tool 'wheel'; an unknown tool returns HTTP 400 with an error message and the list of valid tools; an unknown force value is ignored. Answers are random, so any single call's word, phrase and answer will differ. The docs state a soft per-IP rate limit of about 60 requests per minute (not tested).
True when the verdict was set with the force parameter.
